column1: USE CASE 01 — ブライダル前撮り
式の前に、
物語を一本
棚にある 620 以上の前撮りの様式(和装・洋装・韓国風・台湾の婚紗・中華風)から選んで、声で相談するだけ。礼拝堂も、港も、神社も——写真と短い動画を、手元の PC で焼く。衣装も髪も、同じ顔のまま何通りでも。
column2: Choose from over 620 pre-wedding looks (Japanese, Western, Korean, Taiwanese and Chinese bridal) and talk it through. Chapels, harbors, shrines—photos and short videos, generated on your own PC. Any number of outfits and hairstyles, always the same face.

column2: Not hunting for buttons—talking with a pro. "A pre-wedding shoot in a chapel by the sea"—that's all it takes for the director to plan it out.

column1: 場所の雰囲気、衣装、二人の距離感。言葉にできる所だけでいい。参考の写真があれば貼るだけ。
column2: The feel of the place, the outfits, how close the two of you stand. Only what you can put into words. If you have a reference photo, just paste it.
